```{r setup-mascot_status, include = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
```

### Status line or speech bubble?

|                | Status line                                  | Speech bubble                           |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------|
| Visible        | Always, under the mascot                     | Until it times out or is closed         |
| Screen readers | Announced politely when it changes           | Announced politely when it appears      |
| Use it for     | The current state: "Checking 120 rows"       | News: "Three rows were skipped"         |
| Set it         | `status = "text"`                            | `bubble = "text"`                       |
| Clear it       | `status = mascot_status()`                   | `bubble = mascot_bubble()`              |
